name: Fast steps blocks clip: a step-up teleports the dot up through a slab
techNote: A floor under an 8-thick slab whose underside is 74 u up (the dot's 72-tall hitbox fits under it with 2 u to spare, so no jump gets through), and a 40-tall block on the floor under the slab. Run right: the step-up teleports the dot onto the block (y = 40 + 36), which puts the hitbox (y 42-114) across the slab (74-82); Box2D pushes it out upward, onto the slab's top, where the finish box is. The step is a teleport: nothing between the feet and the new height stops it. Offline control: the same run without the block stays under the slab.
